Dyeing will make the hair more uniformly one color making the overall appearance a little fuller. Let's get on to the dyeing. if you use just for men everything comes applied for you so there's no need to worry about picking up a brush like you would with a biggin you don't have to pick up any other containers you can do the dyeing with everything that's applied within the box itself here are the instructions for jfm simply pause the video if you want to read them the first thing you'll want to do is wash your beard thoroughly to remove any oils that are built up this is so that the dye can adhere to the hair and let the shafts take in the color i'm using dr bronner's peppermint cast style soap here one thing of note is that you may want to wash your beard about an hour prior to dying as you'll need it to be bone dry if not you can use a blow dryer as I'm doing here it'll speed things up quite a bit after your beard is dry it's time to start mixing the dye Using both tubes that come in the box, squeeze some out on either side of the plastic tray.
